_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits at the top of the Anxiety band (39-46) in a confirmed coil where the 7-day base rate shows only 3% of 12h windows move ±2+ points, and neither brain has identified a breaker that has actually fired — stablecoin growth is a precondition, not a trigger.
next_move.brains_agree: Split — analyst explicitly calls HOLD with medium conviction; narrative implies an imminent directional reversal to UP but provides no trigger condition, only a structural setup.
next_move.confirmed_if: LONG — triggered by ETF flows breaking above 20 or MVRV Z-score climbing above 30, which would shift the phase to Disbelief and validate the stablecoin dry powder deployment thesis.
next_move.invalidated_if: SHORT_AGGRESSIVE or REDUCE — triggered by Fear & Greed collapsing below 20 or VIX spiking above 25, which would drop the phase to Denial/Panic and signal the coil is breaking downward.
